Frozen pre-change baseline
===========================

These files are the parity baseline for the format-mark tests.
They are the preview commit below, not the candidate working tree.
A later commit of the candidate does not move them.

Source commit: 9a583f2fba8773791743115e4953d2cbda119992
Subject: Include 0.7.3 fast path
